body:
So I tried that @bobylito but then when you build custom react widgets and want to publish them as jsdelivr `<script>` (because you do not want to limit your widgets to a public that is only browserify/webpack) that's an issue.

For us, we can rely on some "DI" by reusing the instantsearch.deps.\* in widgets but then if your custom widget wants to reuse any existing react component (say react-google-maps) then it will fail because we are not be able to inject "OUR" react into their component.

The underlying reused component (google-maps) will just try to require("react") which will fail.
